propositions: Rebar's LLM runtime is documented to support base_url and api_key composition but rejects them at runtime in _pai_check_config, contradicting docs and config.py parsing

Rebar has no native Bedrock provider path; Bedrock access requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy that silently loses prompt caching, retrying tenacity transport, per-request read timeout, and native structured output
The hardcoded _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS name set and inline anthropic branch checks in runner.py/structured.py couple provider selection to string prefix matching rather than capability profiles
Signed verdict sidecars record a model string that no longer names the actual provider when routed through a gateway, losing attestation provenance
Retry and timeout configuration (llm_retry_max_attempts, llm_retry_max_wait_s, timeout_s) are applied only to the direct-Anthropic path via httpx, not to the live Bedrock production path via botocore
